sed.kind: approximate SED from forced aperture photometry
sed.caveat: Aperture fluxes without aperture correction; the PSF size changes with wavelength, so the spectral shape is approximate. Not a calibrated spectrum; no molecular detection is claimed.

controls.method: leave-one-out per-exposure offsets; Gaia DR3 catalogue motion (and parallax) as truth

photocentre.reason: needs >= 8 epochs with position and flux, have 5

log: Reference reused from dossier 293db9dc252b: Sesame/S=Simbad, IDIA (via url) WISEA J085510.74-071442.5
Pinned observations: 110 (archive discovery skipped for reproduction)
Field calibration: 59 Gaia stars, 91 frames calibrated, systematic floor 0.348", photometric floor 0.00791107089627019
Reanalysis of 293db9dc252b with 110 cached exposures (union of all cached analyses)

verdicts.rule: every measured frame has archive URL + SHA-256
centroid S/N >= threshold, at the predicted position, in >= 3 epochs
per-exposure offsets from >= 3 Gaia field stars in >= 3 exposures

constant flux rejected at p < 1e-3 within same-wavelength bins (errors incl. field-star floor); VARIABLE if max/min >= 1.2 and the rejection is seen in >= 2 bins with aperture photometry; otherwise POSSIBLE (low amplitude / one bin / saturated core)

5-parameter fit (offset, proper motion, parallax) with no catalogue input; reliable only if the target is unsaturated (<50% of epochs with a flagged core), shows no photocentre shift, and the field stars' fitted parallaxes agree with Gaia (<=10% beyond 3 sigma, z spread < 2); detected if >= 3 sigma
Gaia field stars through the same pipeline: <=10% with |z|>3 and z spread < 2

caveats: Some fluxes come from a Gaussian fit to unflagged PSF wings because the core was flagged (e.g. saturated); they are compared only with each other.
Positions are measured with a circular-Gaussian approximation to the PSF on native pixels; the PSF extension is not yet used (ePSF fitting is a planned upgrade).
Fluxes are aperture fluxes without aperture correction; compare only within a wavelength bin.
A significant motion or variability statistic identifies a candidate for follow-up, not a discovery.
Reference astrometry from SIMBAD (no Gaia DR3 match); catalogue uncertainties not propagated.

reproduce.note: Re-runs the identical request/settings and compares file hashes and results.
